section.div: Source code of extensions for the Tachiyomi app.
Source extensions for the Tachiyomi app.
This script will fetch seasonal anime data from MyAnimeList (both Normal and Hentai) and Hentai anime data from NekoPoi and save it in a specified format.
This script will automatically rename any NekoPoi titles (well its for all video titles btw, but mainly used for NekoPoi)

Favorites genres: Fantasy, Comedy, Action, Adventure, Romance

div.div:
Based on the erotic game by Dwarfsoft.
A middle-aged man has lost his job and home because of his arrogant nature. Leading a vagrant lifestyle he became embittered and aggressive towards society. One day he meets a mysterious beauty Shima Itski, who invites him to become the founder of the sex cult “Ishin No Kai” and in addition to this, she offers him a huge amount of money, a house, and a car. Of course, our hero just could not refuse the sultry beauty and now he has become the “Lord” of a mad sex cult with unimaginably depraved rituals…
(Source: hentaihaven)
Action, Adventure, Drama, Ecchi, Fantasy, Romance

Yuuki Wakura watches as dueling supernatural forces ravage the Earth. Mato are portals to another dimension, avenues from which dangerous monsters escape. Peaches are resources given to women granting them abilities. Chief of the Seventh Unity of the Anti-Demon Corp, Kyouka Uzen arrives to save Yuuki from a monster. Surprisingly, Yuuki holds the power to increase the Peaches effectiveness. But to save the world, Yuuki must be willing to become Kyouka’s servant both on the battlefield and at home.
(Source: HIDIVE)
Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken 2nd Season Part 2

The nation of Tempest is in a festive mood after successfully overcoming the surprise attack from the Falmuth Army and the Western Holy Church. Beyond the festivities lies a meeting between Tempest and its allies to decide the future of the Nation of Monsters. The aftermath of the Falmuth invasion, Milim Nava's suspicious behavior, and the disappearance of Demon Lord Carrion—the problems seem to keep on piling up.
Rimuru Tempest, now awakened as a "True Demon Lord," decides to go on the offensive against Clayman. With the fully revived "Storm Dragon" Veldora, "Ultimate Skill" Raphael, and other powerful comrades, the ruler of the Tempest is confident in taking down his enemies one by one until he can face the man pulling the strings.

Based on the erotic game by Lune.
Bad plan of the Principal of Women's School that made new policy and allowed a male student to attend and attend Ikenue Takumi Women's School. She plans to make Ikenue look strange and unnatural because she's just a male student herself. However, Ikenue wants to take revenge on them all after learning that the Headmaster has a magical item that is a Music Box with magical powers that can make people exposed to hypnosis.
(Source: Nekopoi and Has Been Translated and Edited)
Megami "Isekai Tensei Nani ni Naritai Desu ka" Ore "Yuusha no Rokkotsu de"

My reincarnation destination is... “the rib of a harem-loving, happy-ending, overpowered hero”!? An isekai reincarnation anime that defies animation conventions is born!
Beyond traditional animation, this series delivers an exhilarating isekai reincarnation tale through unconventional techniques like stop-motion, puppet theater, and live-action—featuring the aloof “Goddess” in charge of isekai reincarnations and the protagonist “Me,” who endures one absurd reincarnation after another!
(Source: YouTube Channel, translated)
Action, Adventure, Drama, Ecchi, Fantasy, Romance

Yuuki Wakura watches as dueling supernatural forces ravage the Earth. Mato are portals to another dimension, avenues from which dangerous monsters escape. Peaches are resources given to women granting them abilities. Chief of the Seventh Unity of the Anti-Demon Corp, Kyouka Uzen arrives to save Yuuki from a monster. Surprisingly, Yuuki holds the power to increase the Peaches effectiveness. But to save the world, Yuuki must be willing to become Kyouka’s servant both on the battlefield and at home.
(Source: HIDIVE)

Having spent his childhood in the slums, Hajime Shinonome desperately sought strength to survive.
Now, he enjoys a peaceful and carefree life as a resident adventurer of the Komai Village.
One day, during a quest, he ventured into a dungeon and finds a young girl being partially eaten by a weakest kind of monster, a slime!
The girl's name was Lirui. Having been abandoned by her parents, she had no place to go and entered the dungeon alone in order to stay alive. Hajime couldn't just leave her there, so he took her back to the village to live with him! (Source: Crunchyroll)
S-Rank Monster no "Behemoth" Dakedo, Neko to Machigawarete Elf Musume no Pet to Shite Kurashitemasu

Nobody asked to be a cat!
After dying in a fight against the forces of evil, a knight is shocked to discover that instead of being reborn as a hero of humanity, he starts his new life as a behemoth-one of the most powerful monsters in the world! The only problem is that a baby behemoth looks an awful lot like...an adorable house cat?! Things grow even more confusing when a beautiful elf adventurer rescues him from the brink of death rather than finishing him off. This house-cat-slash-knight's baffling journey is just getting started...
(Source: Yen Press)
Tensei Colosseum: Saijaku Skill de Saikyou no Onna-tachi wo Kouryaku Shite Dorei Harem Tsukurimasu

The story begins when high school boy Mikagami, whose only redeeming feature is his skills in video games, is summoned to a different world. He has only the weakest skill "Copy" and, for being useless, he is turned into a sword-fighting slave in the coliseum. Mikagami is pale in the face of the coliseum, where the worst punishment is that "the loser becomes the winner's slave and is mated". The story depicts how he uses his weakest skill "Copy" with the confidence that he has never lost in a "game" before, and how he manages to defeat the stronger players in a duel as if it were a game.
(Source: Comic Natalie)
Comedy, Drama, Hentai, Slice of Life
Still a virgin, I downloaded an app. [Welcome to 'The Heroine App'.]. I can get any girl I want with this app?! What am I waiting for? (Source: DAYcomics)

YUN-HO starts studying to get a government job after failing to get into college. One day, he has a strange dream and now he can see people's status! [Mission: Punish A Woman] He decides to use his new powers to get revenge on women who's been rude to him... (Source: TOPTOON+)
Yuusha desu ga, Heroine-tachi ni Inochi wo Nerawareteimasu

Frey is the anti-hero who killed his loved ones and doomed the world. But his true goal was to open the hidden route and save the heroines from their fated deaths. Reborn in the past, Frey has a chance to change destiny... until he realizes the five heroines he once killed remember everything, and this time, they want him dead. (Source: Manta)
